newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Five Thai crew missing from cargo ship off S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Five Thai crew missing from cargo ship off S.Korea.

text.p: Five Thai crew members were missing in South Korean waters on Thursday after their cargo ship ran aground just off the port city of Pusan, South Korean maritime police said.
"Five out of the total 29 crew members are found to be missing. They are all believed to be drowned," a police spokesman said.
All 29 crew were Thai, he said.
Police earlier said two crew were missing and were working to save three survivors stuck in the wreck of the ill-fated Thai-flagged ship "Jutha Jessica".
"It looks like we've lost the three. So we suspended the resecue operation and instead began the seaching for bodies," the spokesman said.
The ship broke in two on Wednesday afternoon after hitting a rock in heavy seas.
